source: BMKG administrative codes (one representative desa/kelurahan per kabupaten/kota, https://github.com/Mikhaells/Prakiraan-Cuaca-Indonesia----BMKG) joined with cahyadsn/wilayah (MIT) coordinates, capitals, area and population (Kepmendagri No 300.2.2-2430 Tahun 2025).
note: One representative desa/kelurahan (adm4) per kabupaten/kota, used as a starting point for the BMKG forecast API. lat/lon are the regency centroids from cahyadsn/wilayah, not the forecast village. Village-level codes can be entered manually in the workspace.
